Return the original label Entailment (supported), Contradiction (opposed), or NotMentioned (not settled by the document); do not substitute external law for contractual text. Decide the relation relative to the exact original hypothesis, including its negation, not whether the contract contains a prohibition. The same 17 hypotheses are checked on every document. All original text is present, with zero-based original span markers <SPAN i>...</SPAN i>. For supported/opposed hypotheses cite all original evidence span indices for that decision, including independently operative redundant support and necessary governing language. For NotMentioned return an empty evidence list. Treat conditions and exceptions within scope, and distinguish limited permission from universal permission. Give a short public reason (at most 15 words per hypothesis), then report supplied skill IDs actually used. Skills are fallible reusable inspection procedures, not facts about this NDA or automatic verdicts. All skills are visible together; public hypothesis IDs describe applicability, not hidden context isolation. Do not execute further tools, invent citations or rewrite span indices. Return exactly the supplied JSON schema with all 17 original hypothesis keys. For each emit choice, spans, reason, used_skill_ids in that order. The common schema describes permitted values, not answers about this contract. Evidence candidates are fallible, not mandatory citations; make every final label and evidence decision yourself from the complete original contract. All17 public tasks share the complete source and one-copy published_source_programs library. A question's applicable_published_skills contains ID references to those complete named records, not missing guidance. Read their inspection and the one-copy source_program_query_receipts. SOURCE_LEADS tags before original SPANs identify mechanical query/list hits by skill ID/query index, not labels or proven relevance. Only original contract text is evidence. Preserve original SPAN indices. A different question's skill is not a condition this question must satisfy. Missing skills/empty hits never mean NotMentioned. Independently inspect the entire source, reject noisy leads, retain independent/governing evidence and make every final label and complete evidence decision yourself. used_skill_ids must come from this question's ID references and may be empty.

{"full_contract_with_original_span_markers":"<SPAN 0>TTP Non-Disclosure </SPAN 0><SPAN 1>Agreement</SPAN 1>
<SPAN 2>1. Purpose. </SPAN 2><SPAN 3>Technology Transfer Partners (“TTP”) is a group of Micro Focus network administrators and network architects working in school, college, university or government settings. </SPAN 3><SPAN 4>This group meets and shares ideas and experiences, and recommendations about network environments. </SPAN 4><SPAN 5>The purpose of this Non-Disclosure Agreement (“Agreement”) is to protect Confidential Information shared by the parties or by other members of the TTP group in the TTP mailing list or TTP meetings.</SPAN 5>
<SPAN 6>Micro Focus Software Inc. ("Micro Focus") and the "Individual" identified below agree to the following provisions. </SPAN 6><SPAN 7>The terms “Discloser” and “Recipient” as used herein apply to both parties to this Agreement in their respective roles as discloser of Confidential Information and recipient of Confidential Information.</SPAN 7>
<SPAN 8>2. Confidential Information. </SPAN 8><SPAN 9>Information that shall be considered "Confidential Information" shall be </SPAN 9><SPAN 10>(i) any Information disclosed by Micro Focus, Individual, or another TTP member on the TTP mailing list or during a TTP meeting that contains information regarding the Discloser’s network or business environment or experiences, or information regarding the business plans or personnel or finances of the Discloser, </SPAN 10><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-definition-form-identification-evidence":[2]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 11>(ii) any information Discloser can show should be reasonably understood to be proprietary to Discloser, and </SPAN 11><SPAN 12>(iii) information marked in writing as "confidential."</SPAN 12>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-exception-source-development-evidence":[0]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 13>Confidential Information does not include information that </SPAN 13><SPAN 14>(1) is already in Recipient’s possession without obligation of confidence; or </SPAN 14><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-exception-source-development-evidence":[0]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 15>(2) Recipient independently develops; or </SPAN 15><SPAN 16>(3) is or becomes publicly available without breach of the Agreement; or </SPAN 16><SPAN 17>(4) Recipient rightfully receives from a third party without obligation of confidence; or </SPAN 17><SPAN 18>(5) Discloser releases for disclosure by giving written consent; or </SPAN 18><SPAN 19>(6) is required to be disclosed by court or regulatory rule or order.</SPAN 19>
<SPAN 20>3. Permissible Use. </SPAN 20><SPAN 21>Recipient may use and disclose the Confidential Information among its internal information technology and management staff for its own internal business purposes. </SPAN 21><SPAN 22>Either party may also disclose on the TTP mailing list Confidential Information previously received on the TTP mailing list or during TTP meetings. </SPAN 22><SPAN 23>Micro Focus may post for use of the TTP program a list of the organizations and individuals that have signed a Micro Focus TTP Non-disclosure Agreement.</SPAN 23>
<SPAN 24>4. Obligation of Confidentiality. </SPAN 24><SPAN 25>For a period of 3 years from the date of disclosure, Recipient agrees to use the same care and discretion as it uses with its own confidential information to avoid, except as expressly permitted in this Agreement, disclosure or publication of Discloser’s Confidential Information. </SPAN 25><SPAN 26>At a minimum shall Recipient use reasonable care to protect Confidential Information.</SPAN 26>
<SPAN 27>5. Ownership. </SPAN 27><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-rights-license-purpose-evidence":[2]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 28>All Confidential Information remains the property of the Discloser and/or its licensors.</SPAN 28>
<SPAN 29>6. Freedom of Use. </SPAN 29><SPAN 30>Recipient shall be free to use for any purposes Residuals resulting from access to or work with Discloser’s Confidential Information. </SPAN 30><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-definition-form-identification-evidence":[3],"nda-rights-license-purpose-evidence":[0]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 31>However, the foregoing does not give Recipient the right to disclose the financial, statistical, or personnel information or the business plans of Discloser, and shall not be deemed to grant to either party a license under the other party’s copyrights or patents. </SPAN 31><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-return-copy-retention-evidence":[2],"nda-definition-form-identification-evidence":[0]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 32>The term "Residuals" means information which may be retained in non-tangible form by persons who have had access to the Confidential Information, including without limitation general ideas, concepts, know-how or techniques contained therein. </SPAN 32><SPAN 33>Neither party shall have any obligation to limit or restrict the assignment or reassignment of personnel.</SPAN 33>
<SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-definition-form-identification-evidence":[3],"nda-exception-source-development-evidence":[0]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 34>Except as otherwise provided in this Agreement, the parties acknowledge that the communications hereunder will not serve to impair the right of either party to independently develop, make, use, procure or market products or services now or in the future that may be similar to or competitive with those offered by Discloser, nor require Recipient to disclose any planning or other information to Discloser. </SPAN 34><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-survival-continuity-evidence":[0]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 35>This Section shall survive termination of this Agreement.</SPAN 35>
<SPAN 36>7. Termination. </SPAN 36><SPAN 37>This Agreement shall begin on the date it is executed and shall extend until that date which is six (6) months after the date on which Individual ceases to be a participant in TTP. </SPAN 37><SPAN 38>Either party may terminate this Agreement for its convenience upon written notice to the other. </SPAN 38><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-return-copy-retention-evidence":[0,1]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 39>Upon termination of this Agreement, or earlier upon Discloser’s request, Recipient shall promptly return or destroy all documents and tangible items in its possession which contain any part of the Confidential Information of Discloser. </SPAN 39><SOURCE_LEADS>{"nda-survival-continuity-evidence":[0]}</SOURCE_LEADS><SPAN 40>Upon Agreement termination, all obligations of confidentiality shall survive and continue to bind Recipient in accordance with their terms.</SPAN 40>
<SPAN 41>8. Disclaimer. </SPAN 41><SPAN 42>All Confidential Information is provided AS IS, WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, WHETHER EXPRESS OR IMPLIED. </SPAN 42><SPAN 43>Discloser does not represent or warrant the accuracy or completeness of the Confidential Information, that it will release any related product, or that target dates will be met. </SPAN 43><SPAN 44>The entire risk arising out of the use of the Confidential Information remains with Recipient. </SPAN 44><SPAN 45>Discloser may change or cancel its plans at any time.</SPAN 45>
<SPAN 46>9. Limitation of Liability. </SPAN 46><SPAN 47>IN NO EVENT SHALL DISCLOSER BE LIABLE FOR ANY DAMAGES WHATSOEVER (INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION DAMAGES FOR LOSS OF BUSINESS PROFITS, BUSINESS INTERRUPTION, OR OTHER PECUNIARY LOSS) </SPAN 47><SPAN 48>ARISING OUT OF RECIPIENT'S USE OF OR INABILITY TO USE THE CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION.</SPAN 48>
<SPAN 49>10. General.</SPAN 49>
<SPAN 50>a. This Agreement shall be governed and construed in accordance with the laws of Utah (without regard to conflicts of laws provisions). </SPAN 50><SPAN 51>In any legal proceeding arising out of this Agreement, the prevailing party shall be entitled to an award of its costs and reasonable attorneys' fees. </SPAN 51><SPAN 52>The parties agree that Utah state and federal courts shall have jurisdiction and venue in any such proceeding.</SPAN 52>
<SPAN 53>b. Export Constraints. </SPAN 53><SPAN 54>Recipient shall follow U.S. Export Administration laws and regulations and shall not export or re-export any technical data or products received from Discloser or the direct product of such technical data to any proscribed country listed in the U.S. Export Administration regulations unless properly authorized by the U.S. government.</SPAN 54>
<SPAN 55>c. Neither party may assign its rights or delegate its duties or obligations under this Agreement without prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld. </SPAN 55><SPAN 56>The parties acknowledge that they have read this Agreement, understand it, and agree to be bound by the terms and conditions. </SPAN 56><SPAN 57>Further, they agree that the complete and exclusive statement of the agreement between the parties relating to this subject shall consist of this Agreement.</SPAN 57>
